name: A follow-up chat summarises the results
looks: Under a different numbered step tag ("03 - READ THE ANSWERS"), a short chat request asks for a summary; the reply opens with a one-line total, then a short bulleted list of findings types in, each bullet landing on its own beat with a key phrase set in the accent colour.
build: Step tag swaps to its new label and number via cross-fade. The reply's headline count appears first, then bullets clip in top to bottom 150-200ms apart, with the one key phrase per bullet (a name, a number) coloured to stand out from the rest of the line.
sound: A soft typewriter patter under the request, a light tick per bullet landing.
prompt: Under a numbered step tag for the final stage of a flow, ask a quick follow-up question in chat and have the reply open with a one-line total before a short bulleted list of findings types in one line at a time, each with one key phrase picked out in the accent colour.
